before.result: Flat translucent cyan pyramid and blurred rectangular waterfall reproduce the reported defects.

after.result: Crystal silhouette is dimensional and recognizably mineral; first palette too cobalt and waterfall too thin/dark. Retained as first candidate evidence.

after-refined.result: Pale blue-white crystal internal falloff, readable separate facets and unequal spires. Wider pale falling sheets retain physical gaps and low impact foam. Three motion samples show changing flow/impact patterns without a detached particle box.

stand_inspection.intake_gallery: Distant crystal/falls remain visible on the same hall axis. Existing corridor and companion unchanged in scope.
stand_inspection.pump_hall: Multi-tip crystal silhouette replaces the single pyramid; sheet gaps and blue-white destination read from the room entrance.
stand_inspection.sluice_crossing: Hero subject remains centered on the bridge approach. Existing flat channel surface and submerged companion presentation remain outside this asset change.
stand_inspection.heart_chamber_entry: Crystal facets and pale centre are clear; waterfall has uneven widths and impact crowns instead of a blurry backing rectangle.
stand_inspection.heart_chamber_crystal: All visible crystal surfaces are closed with no missing front faces; shader override confirmed. Existing central control box occludes the low termination. Falls touch the existing pool and stay behind the crystal.
stand_inspection.heart_chamber_banner: Assets outside frame; existing banner/lamps/walls retain presentation. No new visual intrusion.

integration_check: after-refined/integration-check.json: original parent remains (0,5,113), visual child offset (0,-5,0), AABB 5x10x2.884579m, ShaderMaterial assigned, visible before release and hidden after real water_guardian_freed flag plus production _refresh.
test: geometry-test.log: test_water_veilfall_geometry.gd passed; 1 runner test / 5 assertions / 0 failures, including isolated child geometry and authority fixture with >300 assertions.
log_scan: No SCRIPT ERROR, ERROR or shader compile failure. Existing physics interpolation deprecation warning remains in both baseline and candidate.
proposed_integration: Apply integration.patch to the Tidewake lane's current construction functions after reconciling lane ownership. Add both asset folders. Keep crystal gameplay parent, freed-state visibility, existing light, waterfall centre/config, plunge pool and fall light. No collider or gameplay logic change.
limitations: This is an author inspection, not an independent code-blind acceptance verdict.
Waterfall still has a repeated vertical-ribbon rhythm; independent judge must decide the scoped asset bar.
Existing low flat ceiling, plain control blocks, generic masonry and banner placeholder remain broader chamber identity/finish defects.
Three sampled frames demonstrate animation changes but do not establish continuous-motion polish or hardware performance.
No ROG Ally performance or full-chapter Bars A/B claim is made.
